workflowLanding.faqQ1: How does the direct email extraction work without hallucinating?
workflowLanding.faqA1: Our workflow enforces a strict two-part rule: an email address is populated only if (1) it literally appears inside the LinkedIn post text, and (2) the author explicitly designates it as the application channel. If no email is stated in the post, the system notifies you cleanly instead of guessing an address that bounces.
workflowLanding.faqQ2: How long does a full 3-layer inspection take?
workflowLanding.faqA2: Because JobPost X-Ray performs live multi-stage extraction across the LinkedIn post, the author's profile, and the company's official page before synthesizing the report, a typical scan completes in moments (usually under a minute, or slightly longer if a link requires deep company resolution). Both the Web Dashboard and Telegram Bot display live step-by-step progress updates.
workflowLanding.faqQ3: How does the Community & Curator format help Telegram or Slack admins?
workflowLanding.faqA3: Instead of manually reading unstructured LinkedIn posts and re-typing job summaries for your members, you simply send the link to JobPost X-Ray. You get a clean, verified Arabic or English summary with role requirements, company size, geographic presence, and direct application instructions ready to publish to your channel in one click.
workflowLanding.faqQ4: Is my Google Drive and Gmail account safe?
workflowLanding.faqA4: Yes. We only request permission to fetch your designated CV file and the restricted gmail.compose scope to create a draft inside your Gmail Drafts folder. Nothing is ever sent automatically without your review.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: At EpiFlow, we hold data privacy, cryptographic security, and third-party transparency as foundational principles. This Privacy Policy details how we collect, process, store, and safeguard your personal data across our web application, APIs, and Telegram bot integrations.
privacy.tocLemonSqueezy: • Payments via Lemon Squeezy (Merchant of Record)
privacy.sec1Lead: We strictly adhere to data minimization principles. We only collect and process data that is indispensable for delivering autonomous recruitment intelligence and executing user-requested workflow actions.
privacy.sec1Item1Desc: When you sign in to EpiFlow, we authenticate you via Google OAuth. We receive your verified email address, full name, and avatar image. We do not store or manage passwords.
privacy.sec1Item2Desc: To inspect a recruitment opportunity, you submit a public job post URL (such as a LinkedIn link). Our workflow processes the publicly accessible text of the post, the author's public profile summary, and official company metadata.
privacy.sec1Item3Desc: You may voluntarily upload a resume/CV or link a Google Drive document in your workflow profile. This document is utilized strictly as context to evaluate candidate fit or draft outreach emails upon your command.
privacy.sec1Item4Desc: We record transactional metadata including run timestamps, scan quota consumption, execution statuses (e.g. completed, failed), and error telemetry. We never log confidential tokens, passwords, or resume bodies into application logs.
privacy.sec2Lead: Our platform relies on trusted external APIs to automate recruitment intelligence. We provide complete transparency into each provider's scope, permissions, and data handling guarantees:
privacy.googleApiP1: EpiFlow accesses Google user data strictly to support Google Sign-In and the optional 1-Click Gmail Draft feature. When you authorize Gmail integration, we request the restricted scope 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.compose'.
privacy.googleApiP2: We use this scope solely to create an unsent draft in your personal Gmail Drafts folder upon your direct manual request. EpiFlow NEVER reads, inspects, parses, or searches your existing email inbox or sent messages, NEVER dispatches emails automatically without your review, and NEVER shares, sells, or transfers your Google data to third parties, advertising networks, or data brokers.
privacy.googleApiLimitedUse: EpiFlow's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
privacy.googleApiTokens: All Google OAuth refresh tokens are encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption with per-record initialization vectors.
privacy.apifyP1: When you submit a LinkedIn job posting URL, our platform delegates extraction to Apify automated actors. These actors fetch only publicly accessible web data (post text, author public profile, company overview).
privacy.apifyP2: We never access private LinkedIn accounts, private messaging, connections, or password-protected content. Scraped public data is cached ephemerally to eliminate redundant requests and optimize bandwidth.
privacy.aiTitle: Artificial Intelligence Engines (Google Gemini & Anthropic Claude)
privacy.aiP1: Extracted public job text is processed by Google Gemini and Anthropic Claude APIs to summarize key requirements, identify verified contact emails, and synthesize intelligence reports.
privacy.aiP2: All inputs are processed as untrusted data blocks. Under our commercial developer API agreements with Google and Anthropic, your data is NOT used to train or improve public foundation AI models. Data transmission is ephemeral and encrypted in transit.
privacy.telegramP1: Users may optionally connect their Telegram account to JobPost X-Ray using a single-use cryptographic token expiring in 10 minutes. We store your Telegram User ID to route reports and updates directly to your private chat.
privacy.telegramP2: We do not read your personal chats, contacts, or channels. You can disconnect your Telegram link at any time from your settings.
privacy.databaseP1: Application records, access permissions, and report histories are hosted on Supabase enterprise PostgreSQL infrastructure. Database connections are encrypted with SSL/TLS.
privacy.databaseP2: Row Level Security (RLS) policies are strictly enforced across all database tables, guaranteeing that a user can never access, query, or mutate another user's reports or credentials.
privacy.lemonSqueezyP1: When you subscribe to a paid tier or purchase workflow credits, transactions are processed and fulfilled by our global Merchant of Record, Lemon Squeezy (Lemon Squeezy, LLC). Lemon Squeezy is responsible for secure checkout handling, invoicing, and calculating statutory sales taxes (EU VAT, US sales tax) worldwide.
privacy.lemonSqueezyP2: All payment card details, billing addresses, and security codes are submitted directly to Lemon Squeezy over TLS 1.3 encryption and handled under strict PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance. EpiFlow NEVER receives, inspects, or stores your credit card numbers on our servers.
privacy.lemonSqueezyTokens: EpiFlow only retains non-sensitive operational identifiers (such as Lemon Squeezy subscription IDs, payment timestamps, and subscription statuses) necessary to provision your workflow quotas and access levels.
privacy.sec3Title: 3. Purpose and Legal Bases for Processing
privacy.sec3Lead: Under applicable privacy laws (such as GDPR Art. 6), we process your personal data under the following legal bases:
privacy.sec3Contract: Performance of a Contract: To provide the core intelligence workflows, process submitted URLs, authenticate your session, and create requested Gmail drafts.
privacy.sec3Consent: Consent: When you opt into connecting your Telegram account or authorizing Google Workspace integrations.
privacy.sec3Legitimate: Legitimate Interests: To prevent malicious automated abuse, enforce rate limits and plan quotas, and ensure platform security.
privacy.sec3Compliance: Legal Compliance: To comply with statutory obligations and respond to lawful legal requests.
privacy.sec4P1: Security is engineered into our architecture at every layer:
privacy.sec4Item1: AES-256-GCM Encryption: Third-party OAuth refresh tokens are encrypted at rest with distinct initialization vectors.
privacy.sec4Item2: End-to-End Transit Encryption: All HTTP and WebSocket communications enforce TLS 1.3 encryption.
privacy.sec4Item3: Deterministic Verification: Email addresses are strictly verified against source post text using code-level regex validations to eliminate AI hallucinations.
privacy.sec4Item4: Strict Principle of Least Privilege: Internal database roles separate migrations from application queries, and client-side code has zero direct database access.
privacy.sec5P1: You have full sovereignty over your data. We retain your account data and analysis history only as long as your account remains active.
privacy.sec5P2: You may trigger a permanent 'Delete-My-Data' purge at any time by contacting us. Upon confirmation, your user record, associated analysis runs, encrypted tokens, and uploaded CV files are irreversibly deleted from our primary databases.
privacy.sec6P1: EpiFlow utilizes strictly necessary session cookies powered by Auth.js to maintain your authenticated session across browser visits.

refund.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
refund.subtitle: We want you to be completely satisfied with EpiFlow and JobPost X-Ray. This policy outlines how subscription renewals, cancellations, and refund requests are handled transparently via our Merchant of Record, Lemon Squeezy.
refund.sec1Lead: We stand behind the quality of our autonomous recruitment workflows. If you subscribe to any paid plan on EpiFlow and find that it does not meet your expectations, you may request a full 100% refund within fourteen (14) calendar days of your initial purchase.
refund.sec1Notice: Please note that the 14-day refund guarantee applies to the first charge of a new subscription. Subsequent automatic renewals are non-refundable unless required by applicable statutory consumer protection law.
refund.sec2Lead: To protect against misuse of our AI infrastructure and automated data scraping services, refund requests are evaluated under fair usage principles:
refund.sec2Item1: Fair Scan Consumption: To be eligible for a full 14-day refund, your account must have consumed fewer than 10 total workflow scans during the current billing period.
refund.sec2Item2: One Guarantee Per Customer: The money-back guarantee may only be redeemed once per customer, organization, or payment method.
refund.sec2Item3: Terms Compliance: Accounts terminated or suspended due to violations of our Acceptable Use Policy (such as abusive scraping or bulk email harassment) are strictly non-refundable.
refund.sec3Lead: Because all transactions are processed through our Merchant of Record, Lemon Squeezy, requesting a refund is fast and straightforward:
refund.sec3Step1: Send an email to billing@epiflow.io or support@epiflow.io with the subject line 'Refund Request'.
refund.sec3Step2: Include the email address associated with your EpiFlow account and your Lemon Squeezy Order ID (found on your payment receipt email).
refund.sec3Step3: Our team will review your request within 24–48 business hours. Once approved, Lemon Squeezy issues the refund directly to your original payment method (typically appearing on your bank statement within 5–10 business days).
refund.sec4Lead: You are never locked into long-term commitments. You have complete autonomy over your billing:
refund.sec4P1: You may cancel your subscription at any time with a single click either through your EpiFlow Profile settings or directly via the Lemon Squeezy Customer Portal link provided in your receipt.
refund.sec4P2: When you cancel, your subscription will not renew at the next billing cycle. You will retain full access to all paid plan features and scan quotas until the end of your prepaid period.
refund.sec5Lead: If you experience any billing discrepancies, duplicate charges, or issues accessing your purchased tier, please contact us immediately before initiating a bank dispute or chargeback. We are committed to resolving any payment questions amicably and promptly.
